svg.title: The MiniMail window
svg.desc: The MiniMail window: a row of category cards (Invitations, Notifications, Verification codes, Receipts and Newsletters) above the conversation list, grouped by Pinned, Yesterday, This Week, Last Week and November, with the folder buttons, Smart, Sender and List views, and the compose button in the toolbar.
